tools.name: company-intelligence_search

tools.name: company-intelligence_profile

tools.name: company-intelligence_ownership
tools.description: Retrieve parent and subsidiary relationships from GLEIF. tools.name: company-intelligence_financials
tools.description: Retrieve and normalize financial metrics from SEC EDGAR using CIK or ticker. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/company-intelligence/financials Keywords: before you onboard or contract with a company, identifier, found, financials, cik, source, Get company financials, Company Intelligence.

tools.name: company-intelligence_filings
tools.description: Retrieve recent SEC EDGAR filings by CIK or ticker. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/company-intelligence/filings Keywords: SEC filings, EDGAR, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, formTypes, documentUrl, indexUrl, CIK, ticker.

tools.name: company-intelligence_insider-trades
tools.description: Official SEC Form 4 insider transactions for a US-listed issuer by ticker or CIK, parsed from EDGAR ownership XML. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/company-intelligence/insider-trades Keywords: Form 4, insider trades, EDGAR, SEC, ticker, ownership XML.

tools.name: company-intelligence_institutional-holdings
tools.description: Latest official SEC 13F-HR holdings for a filer by ticker or CIK, parsed from the EDGAR information table. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/company-intelligence/institutional-holdings Keywords: 13F, institutional holdings, EDGAR, SEC, CUSIP, portfolio.

tools.name: company-intelligence_vat-id-lookup
tools.description: Validate a supplied EU VAT ID with VIES and/or search GLEIF by company name for official registration numbers. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/company-intelligence/vat-id-lookup Keywords: before you onboard or contract with a company, vatId, companyName, country, limit, query, vatCheck, regi

tools.name: contact_us
tools.description: How to contact BRAINIAC.software support: email, page URL, what to include in a message, and what not to send. Free. Does not send email.
